title: LTX Video upscaler - the plugin, its two sliders, and the dropdown mechanism nobody built
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-553 - Upscalers leave the model picker, as plugins. Phase 1b: the first CONSUMER of the plugin mechanism, which is MPI-580's. **BLOCKED ON MPI-580.**

Fabio, 2026-08-19, closing the MPI-568 bench: "The video upscale is finished, as far as I can understand. The next stage is implementation into the UI as a new upscale selection in the video workspace. It should be part of the dropdown for the upscale models, and when selected, it should give the user the necessary sliders along with a prompt box. It should be implemented as a plugin, just like the image descriptor. Its name should be LTX Video upscaler."

THE SHIPPED NAME IS "LTX Video upscaler" - his words, verbatim.

THIS DOES NOT BUILD A DROPDOWN. Correction from Fabio, 2026-08-19, after the first write-up read as if it did: "this is not a drop-down. This is part of the existing drop-down. Upscale in the history workspace already contains a drop-down to choose a model. Our new LTX upscaler will be part of that drop-down, and when selected, it will unlock the necessary UI to operate it." The dropdown is js/components/Organisms/MpiToolOptionsUpscale/ in the HISTORY workspace, shared by the image and video tools via its `kind` prop. This card adds ONE ENTRY to the video side and the controls behind it. The contribution point itself is MPI-580.

WHAT THIS CARD OWNS: the LTX Video upscaler plugin definition, its commandRegistry op, the app-side v2v workflow, the controls the entry reveals, audio pass-through, and the in-app VRAM measurement. What it does NOT own: the mechanism that lets a plugin contribute an entry or its controls, a Flow's ability to require a plugin, or the shared-dep GC question. All four are MPI-580.

BOTH SLIDERS ARE FULLY SPECIFIED BY MPI-568 - do not re-derive them, do not re-open the defaults. The user sees 0-1 on both and the mapping is hidden ("occulted from the user, as per usual"):
  denoise         UI 0-1 -> sigmas 0.50-0.85, default UI 0.5 (sigma 0.675, exactly mid-range)
  prompt strength UI 0-1 -> cfg 1-3,          default UI 0   (cfg 1.0)
cfg defaults to the no-guidance end ON PURPOSE - Fabio: "Most upscaling jobs do not want too much change anyway." A plan recommendation of 3 was overruled; do not restore it. The measured evidence bounds the RANGE only: steering never saturates (prompt influence at fixed cfg climbs 3.869 -> 9.231 -> 15.948 -> 21.158 with no knee), and the stop is DAMAGE - cfg 5 already speckles and blows contrast on ANY prompt, proven by a base-prompt control, with cfg 7 catastrophic.

THERE IS NOTHING TO DOWNLOAD, AND THAT IS VERIFIED, NOT ASSUMED. `ltx23-spatial-upscaler` is already in js/data/modelConstants/assetDeps.js, already served from R2 (models.cubric.studio), and already listed in the `dependencies` of BOTH LTX 2.3 tiers in models.js. So: no dep entry to author, no R2 upload, and any user with LTX installed already holds every weight this needs - pluginAvailability() derives the plugin to installed for free. Fabio predicted exactly this ("possibly satisfied if an LTX model is installed"). The corollary is MPI-580's to answer: a user WITHOUT LTX faces a plugin whose install is effectively the whole LTX stack.

MPI-557 (Video face detailer) ADOPTS THIS UPSCALER. Fabio: "Video Face Detailer will adopt this upscaler that we've built. So the plug-in will be a requirement for it, as it is a flow." So this plugin has a second consumer before it ships, and MPI-557 is blocked on it. The mechanism that lets a Flow declare a plugin requirement is MPI-580's.

THE 16 GB PEAK IS A PRODUCT CONSTRAINT and this card has to answer it in the app. The graph peaks at 15163-15898 MB of 16380 on the bench - but that is a NORMAL_VRAM ComfyUI on the int8 transformer, and the app runs --lowvram on bf16, so NO number from MPI-568 is an app number. At 97% of the card there is no room for a loaded app engine, so a user with Vision open may not be able to run this unless models unload first. Measure before designing the UI around it.

AUDIO PASS-THROUGH IS OWED HERE and it is UNBUILT, not merely untested. Fabio's call is whatever comes in goes out; the bench drops audio because VHS_LoadVideo is video-only.

THE PROVEN GRAPH is MPI-568's build_v2v.py - 21 nodes, authored rather than carved out of the 135-node production graph. Three things it had to get right that will bite a re-implementation: the LTX 2.3 transformer takes a CONCATENATED AV latent, so an LTXVEmptyLatentAudio of matching frame count must stand in and be dropped by LTXVSeparateAVLatent before decode; LTXVAddGuide silently BILINEAR-rescales any guide to target latent size, so a source-resolution guide pins the model to a blurry reference without erroring; and img_compression must be 0 for a v2v upscale (the 18 in the shipped graph is for conditioning images and degrades the input here). Every LTX frame count must be 8n+1 and every dimension /32.

ROUTING: the plugin's `operation` key points at a commandRegistry op, so this needs an op + workflow wired the app way, not a bench script. It is a plugin - NOT a Flow and NOT a ModelDef, so do not run /mpi-add-model.

LATER: MPI-578 bumps this to the LTX 2.5 upscalers once the engine bump lands. v1 ships on 2.3 - Fabio's call.

VERIFICATION IS USER-UX AND NEEDS A REAL APP. Spin your own (npm run app:isolated), never the user's :3000. Confirm the entry appears in the History VIDEO upscale dropdown, that selecting it reveals the prompt box and both sliders, that the sliders read 0-1 and land on the right sigma/cfg, and run a real upscale end to end with audio surviving.
